name: Tarantula Nebula
tagline: The most violent star-forming region in the Local Group — in a satellite galaxy 160,000 ly away.
history: If the Tarantula Nebula sat at the Orion Nebula's distance it would cast shadows at night — the largest, most active starburst in the Local Group, blazing inside our satellite Large Magellanic Cloud. At its core the super-cluster R136 packs dozens of monster stars including R136a1, the most massive known. The 1987 supernova exploded at its edge — the nearest such event since the telescope's invention.
